reasoning_content: The build started but output wasn't captured. Let me check for the build folder and logs.

python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
c = paramiko.SSHClient()
c.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
c.connect('46.202.154.25', 22, 'root', '2N00py123+++')

# Check build output
c.exec_command("ls -la /opt/areloria/client/android/app/build/ 2>/dev/null || echo 'no build dir'")

# Check logs
stdin, stdout, stderr = c.exec_command("ls -la /opt/areloria/client/android/build/ 2>/dev/null | head -20")

print("Build:", stdout.read().decode())

c.close()
EOF
